Anthracnose.sababu: Fungal infection caused by Colletotrichum species.
Anthracnose.dalili: Dark, sunken lesions on fruits, leaves, and stems.
Anthracnose.matibabu: Apply copper-based fungicides. Remove and destroy infected plant parts.
Anthracnose.kinga: Ensure proper spacing, avoid overhead watering, and use disease-free seeds.

Anthrax_Kimeta.sababu: Bacterial infection caused by Bacillus anthracis.
Anthrax_Kimeta.dalili: Sudden death, bleeding from natural openings, and swollen carcasses.
Anthrax_Kimeta.matibabu: Antibiotics like penicillin if detected early, but often fatal.
Anthrax_Kimeta.kinga: Vaccination of livestock, proper disposal of carcasses, and avoiding contact with infected animals.

Aspergillosis.sababu: Fungal infection caused by Aspergillus species, common in poultry and birds.
Aspergillosis.dalili: Respiratory distress, gasping, and white nodules in lungs.
Aspergillosis.matibabu: Antifungal medications (e.g., itraconazole) and improved ventilation.
Aspergillosis.kinga: Keep bedding dry, avoid moldy feed, and ensure good ventilation.

Avian_Influenza.sababu: Highly contagious viral infection affecting birds.
Avian_Influenza.dalili: Sudden death, swollen heads, respiratory distress, and drop in egg production.
Avian_Influenza.matibabu: No specific treatment; culling is often necessary to prevent spread.
Avian_Influenza.kinga: Strict biosecurity, avoid contact with wild birds, and vaccination where available.

Avian_Leukosis.sababu: Viral infection causing tumors in poultry.
Avian_Leukosis.dalili: Weight loss, pale combs, and tumors in internal organs.
Avian_Leukosis.matibabu: No treatment; infected birds should be culled.
Avian_Leukosis.kinga: Breed from virus-free stock and maintain strict hygiene.

Bacterial blight.sababu: Bacterial infection caused by Xanthomonas species.
Bacterial blight.dalili: Water-soaked spots on leaves that turn brown, often with yellow halos.
Bacterial blight.kinga: Use resistant varieties, crop rotation, and clean tools.

Bacterial Canker.sababu: Bacterial infection causing cankers on stems and branches.
Bacterial Canker.dalili: Sunken, dark lesions on stems, gum exudation, and leaf yellowing.
Bacterial Canker.matibabu: Prune infected branches and apply copper sprays.
Bacterial Canker.kinga: Avoid injuries to plants, disinfect tools, and maintain good orchard hygiene.

Bacterial speck.dalili: Small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruits.
Bacterial speck.matibabu: Copper-based sprays; avoid working in wet fields.
Bacterial speck.kinga: Use certified seeds, crop rotation, and proper spacing.

Bacterial spot.sababu: Bacterial infection (Xanthomonas species) affecting leaves and fruits.
Bacterial spot.dalili: Small, dark, greasy spots on leaves and fruits.
Bacterial spot.matibabu: Copper fungicides and removal of infected leaves.
Bacterial spot.kinga: Use disease-free seeds, crop rotation, and avoid overhead irrigation.

Blossom_Blight.sababu: Fungal infection affecting flowers, often in wet conditions.
Blossom_Blight.dalili: Flowers turn brown and die, leading to fruit drop.
Blossom_Blight.kinga: Improve air circulation and avoid overhead watering.

Brown_Streak_Disease.dalili: Brown streaks on stems, leaf yellowing, and tuber rot.
Brown_Streak_Disease.kinga: Use resistant varieties and control whiteflies.

Candidiasis.dalili: White patches in the mouth and throat, poor growth.
Candidiasis.kinga: Keep water clean and avoid overcrowding.

Coccidiosis.dalili: Bloody diarrhea, weight loss, and weakness.
Coccidiosis.kinga: Keep bedding dry and use coccidiostats in feed.

Downy_Mildew.dalili: Yellow spots on leaves with white/gray fuzz underneath.
Downy_Mildew.matibabu: Fungicides and removal of infected leaves.
Downy_Mildew.kinga: Improve air circulation and avoid wet foliage.

Early_Blight.sababu: Fungal infection (Alternaria solani) in tomatoes and potatoes.
Early_Blight.dalili: Dark spots with concentric rings on leaves and fruits.
Early_Blight.kinga: Use resistant varieties and avoid overhead watering.

East_Coast_Fever.sababu: Parasitic infection (Theileria parva) transmitted by ticks.
East_Coast_Fever.dalili: High fever, swollen lymph nodes, and death.

Foot_and_Mouth_Disease.sababu: Highly contagious viral infection in cloven-hoofed animals.
Foot_and_Mouth_Disease.dalili: Blisters on mouth and feet, lameness, and fever.
Foot_and_Mouth_Disease.matibabu: Supportive care; vaccination is key for control.

Fowl_Cholera.dalili: Sudden death, swollen wattles, and diarrhea.

Fowl_Pox.sababu: Viral infection causing skin lesions in poultry.
Fowl_Pox.dalili: Wart-like nodules on head, combs, and wattles.
Fowl_Pox.matibabu: No cure; supportive care and iodine application.

Fusarium wilt.sababu: Fungal infection (Fusarium) affecting roots and stems.
Fusarium wilt.dalili: Yellowing and wilting of leaves, starting from lower leaves.
Fusarium wilt.kinga: Crop rotation, resistant varieties, and soil solarization.

Gumboro_Infectious_Bursal_Disease.sababu: Highly contagious viral infection in young chickens.
Gumboro_Infectious_Bursal_Disease.dalili: Watery diarrhea, ruffled feathers, and immunosuppression.

healthy animals and agricultural product.dalili: Normal appearance, no lesions, healthy growth.

Homa_ya_Mapafu_ya_Ngombe.sababu: Multiple factors including bacteria and viruses.
Homa_ya_Mapafu_ya_Ngombe.dalili: Coughing, nasal discharge, and difficulty breathing.

Infectious_Bronchitis.sababu: Viral infection in poultry affecting the respiratory system.
Infectious_Bronchitis.dalili: Gasping, sneezing, and drop in egg production.

Infectious_Coryza.dalili: Swollen face, nasal discharge, and sneezing.

Infectious_Laryngotracheitis.sababu: Viral infection in poultry causing respiratory disease.
Infectious_Laryngotracheitis.dalili: Gasping, coughing blood, and swollen heads.
Infectious_Laryngotracheitis.matibabu: No specific treatment; vaccination is key.

Kideri_Newcastle_Disease.sababu: Highly contagious viral infection in birds.
Kideri_Newcastle_Disease.dalili: Respiratory distress, greenish diarrhea, and nervous signs.
Kideri_Newcastle_Disease.matibabu: No cure; vaccination is the main control.

late blight.sababu: Fungal-like organism (Phytophthora infestans) in cool, wet conditions.
late blight.dalili: Water-soaked spots on leaves that turn brown with white fuzz.
late blight.matibabu: Fungicides and removal of infected plants.
late blight.kinga: Resistant varieties and good air circulation.

Mapele_Ngozi.dalili: Itching, hair loss, and scabs on the skin.
Mapele_Ngozi.kinga: Regular dipping and maintaining clean housing.

Mareks_Disease.sababu: Viral infection causing tumors in poultry.
Mareks_Disease.dalili: Paralysis, weight loss, and tumors in nerves.
Mareks_Disease.kinga: Vaccination at day-old and strict hygiene.

Mastitis.sababu: Bacterial infection of the udder in dairy animals.
Mastitis.dalili: Swollen, hot, and painful udder; abnormal milk.
Mastitis.kinga: Good milking hygiene and proper housing.

mosaic disease.sababu: Viral infection causing mottled patterns on leaves.
mosaic disease.dalili: Yellow and green patches on leaves, stunted growth.
mosaic disease.kinga: Use resistant varieties and control insect vectors.

multiple viruses.dalili: Severe symptoms, stunting, and yield loss.
multiple viruses.matibabu: No cure; manage vectors and remove infected plants.
multiple viruses.kinga: Use certified seeds and control vectors.

Ndui.sababu: Viral infection causing skin lesions in poultry.
Ndui.dalili: Wart-like nodules on comb, wattles, and face.
Ndui.matibabu: No cure; apply iodine to lesions and use antibiotics for secondary infections.

Pest_Infestation.sababu: Various insects and pests feeding on plants.
Pest_Infestation.dalili: Chewed leaves, holes in fruits, and presence of insects.
Pest_Infestation.matibabu: Use appropriate insecticides or biological controls.
Pest_Infestation.kinga: Regular monitoring and integrated pest management.

photoplasma disease.kinga: Control insect vectors and use clean planting material.

Pullorum_Disease.dalili: White diarrhea, weakness, and high mortality in chicks.
Pullorum_Disease.kinga: Blood testing and maintaining clean hatcheries.

Rift_Valley_Fever.dalili: Abortion in animals, flu-like symptoms in humans.

Root-knot nematode.dalili: Galls on roots, stunted growth, and yellowing leaves.
Root-knot nematode.kinga: Use resistant varieties and clean soil.

Septoria_Leaf_Spot.dalili: Small, circular spots with dark borders and gray centers.
Septoria_Leaf_Spot.matibabu: Fungicides and removal of infected leaves.
Septoria_Leaf_Spot.kinga: Crop rotation and avoid overhead watering.

Vitamin_Deficiency.sababu: Lack of essential vitamins in the diet.
Vitamin_Deficiency.dalili: Poor growth, weakness, and specific signs like curled toes.
Vitamin_Deficiency.matibabu: Vitamin supplements in feed or water.
Vitamin_Deficiency.kinga: Balanced diet and proper feed formulation.

Whitefly_Infestation.sababu: Small insects (whiteflies) feeding on plant sap.
Whitefly_Infestation.dalili: Whiteflies on leaves, sticky honeydew, and yellowing leaves.
Whitefly_Infestation.kinga: Use yellow sticky traps and resistant varieties.

yellow leaf curl.dalili: Yellowing and curling of leaves, stunted growth.
yellow leaf curl.kinga: Control whiteflies and use resistant varieties.
